items.caption:
This two second reel got me 30,000 followers and sold out a drop from my clothing brand.
Key learning: A participation mechanic can connect attention to a concrete next action. The 30,000 followers, 29,000 DMs, watch-time explanation, and sold-out drop are creator claims, not independently verified metrics. The submitted breakdown is 46.832 seconds; the two-second video mentioned inside it is a different asset.
